name: StageKitWP Theme
author: StageKitWP
short_description: A theme framework for independent theatres with custom homepage sections, dark/light mode, and StageKitWP integration.

sections.description: The StageKitWP Theme provides the front-end presentation layer for StageKitWP content, including customizer controls, dark/light mode, and flexible homepage layouts.
sections.installation: Upload the stagekitwp-theme folder to wp-content/themes/, activate it from Appearance > Themes, and configure it through the Customizer.
sections.changelog: 3.1.4: Upcoming Season Grid toggle is now Off/On/On-if-next-season-exists/On-if-next-season-has-shows, driven by StageKitWP Core's next-season helpers.
